subject: prd/impl-review
statement: If a review mapping or native-profile qualification is found defective after production activation, then the system shall apply FR-29, invalidating all affected open pass/process evidence and requiring complete exact-revision replacement while preserving unaffected and accepted artifacts
intent: affected identities and `rerun_required` or operator-remediation disposition
fit_criterion: seeded defects cover open, unaffected, and already accepted artifacts exactly as FR-29 specifies
